verdict.rationale: LocalAI, a local runtime, documents real-time speech input over WebRTC as part of its voice pipeline, which implies on-device speech recognition at conversational speed. However, the evidence never explicitly describes transcription or dictation output, a transcription endpoint, or a speech-to-text model. Missing for 10: explicit speech-to-text/transcription documentation, a dictation workflow returning text, named on-device STT models, and independent hands-on corroboration of real-time transcription.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: Speech in, tool calls in the middle, speech out over WebRTC, fast enough to feel like a conversation.
Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
Every feature ships a CPU path first.
